title: Outer Shell QR Quick Release Tote
content:
Introducing Outer Shell‘s limited edition QR Tote ($350). Similar to the San Francisco Portage Company’s Everyday Tote, you’ll find the same luxurious look and feel, but with one major upgrade – a custom quick-release mounting system that locks it securely to a rack…

Recessed into the bottom of the bag are robust steel pins that snap into place when set on the magnetic base. A simple pull tab releases the pins to remove the bag. The included mounting plate attaches to any rack and comes in a durable gloss powder-coated finish.

Beyond the highly engineered attachment system, you’ll find daily non-technical style, two sets of ultra-soft rope handles, and all sorts of pockets. We are only making one batch of these in one fabric option – a waterproof black ECOPAK paired with two strap color options.

Specs:

  • Price – $350
  • Quick release mounting system
  • 7″ x 7″ powder coated aluminum base plate (adaptable to any rack)
  • Foam padded bottom with rigid composite mounting plate (soft on contents but stiff for attachment)
  • Small outside sleeve pockets (fits u-lock, phone, wallet, sunglasses)
  • Large outside zipper pocket
  • Large inside zipper pocket
  • Laptop sleeve (fits 13” or 14” MacBook Pro)
  • Side compression straps change shape
  • Main body fabric – ECOPAK EPLX600
  • Liner fabric – 400D Nylon Pack Cloth
  • Weight – 32 oz with mounting plate
  • Dimensions – 11-18″ wide, 14″ tall, 6″ deep

See more at Outer Shell.
